reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance reverses demand ordering. The input needs_df is ordered from highest demand_score to lowest, but the function sorts with key (-demand_score, record_id) and reverse=True, producing evidence_sources ranked n06-r08 first and n06-r01 last. This contradicts demand-priority evidence and feeds the downstream recommendation that prioritizes n06-r07 over the stronger n06-r01 demand record.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank evidence sources by strongest supported demand first
